thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: tenant=hestia high tail latency / queue buildup detected in dedicated-pool-03. alert: HESTIA_QUEUE_LATENCY_P99 > 3s for 5m. link: https://grafana.internal/d/tenants/hestia

eng_oncall: I'm on it. grabbing logs + perf graphs. putting org page on for 15m. can someone ping hestia ops? @hestia_ops

hestia_ops: seeing a spike in long-running 1k-8k token requests from a backfill job. it's not typical traffic shape. we've paused the backfill but queue remains heavy.

eng_oncall: root checks: Dedicated pool 03 showing steady CPU <60% but NVCache thrash and KV cache misses up. per-tenant queue depth ~820, inflight tokens high. hypothesis: single high-token fanout plus continuous-batching causing oversized batches -> increased scheduling latency.

sre_ana: agreed. runbook suggests limiting max_batch_tokens per-tenant and applying queue shaper. recommend immediate change: max_batch_tokens=2048 (was 8192) and set queue_shaper_target=0.6 for hestia. I'll prepare commands.

eng_oncall: make the change and validate. low-risk path: apply control-plane override rather than full deploy. use the tenant-config API:
```bash
# shrink max_batch_tokens and set queue shaper for hestia
curl -sS -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/tenants/hestia/config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"overrides": {"inference.max_batch_tokens": 2048, "inference.queue_shaper_target": 0.6}}'
```

eng_oncall: applying now. will tail the scheduler log for immediate errors.

deploy-bot: (system) change applied to tenant=hestia by eng_oncall at 2026-03-15T10:04:45Z

eng_oncall: confirmation from control-plane: overrides accepted. hitting scheduler metrics:
```promql
sum(rate(redwood_scheduler_batch_size_tokens_bucket{tenant="hestia"}[1m])) by (le)
```
observed 75% drop in >4096 token batches within 30s. queue depth started to drop. p99 latency trending down from 3.4s -> 1.1s at 3m.

maria_support: Hestia engineering reports client-side retries spiking. are we introducing any 429s?

eng_oncall: we shouldn't be. double-checking per-tenant rate limiter. snapshot: 429_count=12 over 10m (normal). no mass 429s.

hestia_ops: thanks — the backfill resumed earlier by mistake before we paused. we confirmed it's paused now. that helped reduce new pressure.

eng_oncall: good. still seeing a minority of long-tail requests stuck in queue. next mitigation: enable per-request max_tokens_override for heavy endpoints and reduce scheduler max_concurrent_batches for hestia pool. planned command:
```bash
rctl tenant update hestia --max-batch-tokens=2048 --queue-shaper=0.6 --max-concurrent-batches=8
```
will apply after we observe stability for 5m.

runtime_pager: placing page to eng-runtime for kernel-level perf anomalies (noticed slight kernel soft-lock warnings on pool nodes). tagging @eng_runtime.

eng_oncall: ack. @kevin_prod please take next handoff in 30m, I'll keep monitoring for the runway. leaving a short checklist below for the handoff.

kevin_prod: taking. joining now. what do I need to watch?

eng_oncall: handoff checklist for @kevin_prod:
- current overrides: inference.max_batch_tokens=2048, queue_shaper_target=0.6 (tenant=hestia)
- metrics to watch: HESTIA_QUEUE_DEPTH, HESTIA_P99_LATENCY, scheduler_batch_size_tokens_bucket, node_nvcache_miss_rate
- commands: tenant override API (above), rctl command (above), force drain + restart worker if nvcache thrash persists:
```bash
# graceful worker restart
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/hestia-worker-0
# or drain node
kubectl drain node/gpu-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
- rollback path: POST same API with previous values (8192 / 0.0) or remove overrides. runbook link: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/tenant-batching

maria_support: notifying Hestia account team: we told them about transient latency and that we applied a per-tenant limit to protect service. they're asking for ETA to fully clear.

hestia_ops: clearing backlog looks like ~10-12 minutes after current rate — we'll confirm when tail p99 < 500ms for 5m.

eng_oncall: observed tail p99 1.1s at +6m, queue depth down from 820 -> 120 at +8m. continuing to trend down. no new 5xx.

runtime_pager: eng_runtime looked at kernel logs; there's a noisy NVCache thread on gpu-03 but it's stable now. recommended we keep overrides for 24h and run deeper profiling during low-traffic window.

kevin_prod: ack takeover. I'll keep devx in the loop and escalate to on-call infra if nvcache spikes again. leaving note to collect traces for hestia jobs flagged >4k tokens.

eng_oncall: handing off to @kevin_prod at 3056788812 (handoff window start). summary for handoff (paste to incident tracker):
- Impact: Hestia tenant experienced elevated queue depth and p99 latency due to large-token backfill causing oversized batch formation in dedicated-pool-03. Customer facing latency spikes for some requests.
- Mitigation: Applied per-tenant overrides: inference.max_batch_tokens=2048, inference.queue_shaper_target=0.6; paused customer backfill; monitored metrics and observed p99 latency drop to ~1.1s and queue depth reducing to baseline within 12 minutes.
- Next steps: keep overrides in place for 24h, schedule root-cause profiling, consider permanent tenant-level batching policy and a guard rail for large token spikes; follow-up runbook update.

maria_support: added note to customer and created support ticket INC-2026-847 for post-incident follow-up.

kevin_prod: taking over. I'll keep this thread updated every 10m or on any regression. marking page as acknowledged and setting my status to on-call. :white_check_mark:

eng_oncall: thanks all, great coordination. closing active page but leaving thread open for follow-up.

deploy-bot: (system) page resolved by eng_oncall -> status: mitigated at 2026-03-15T10:36:52Z

kevin_prod: quick note after takeover at +30m: metrics stable, nvcache miss rate normalized. leaving overrides in place; will schedule performance profiling with eng_runtime for tonight's maintenance window.

hestia_ops: thanks team — we'll adjust our backfill to chunk requests smaller. will follow-up with exact change and confirm in support ticket. :pray:
